svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, #121212); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="ml-model-or-rule" name="Model or rule? (ML models)"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="#ffffff" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;" value="Model or rule? (ML models)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="700" x="20" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="start" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="A number on the site
(priority, decay, intent...)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="20" y="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ovr" parent="1" style="rhombus;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Override
setting" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="130" x="270" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rule" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Use the rule" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="180" x="900" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fresh" parent="1" style="rhombus;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Output fresh?
(within 14 days)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="160" x="680" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="model" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Use the model
(labelled model vN)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="180" x="900" y="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stale" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;" value="Rule
(stale model output)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="180" x="900" y="250" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="active" parent="1" style="rhombus;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Active version?
(beat the rule on
held-out data)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="170" x="440" y="260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rule2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Rule
(no better model yet)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="180" x="900" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="start" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="ovr" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="ovr" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="rule" value="rule"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="ovr" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="fresh" value="model"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="ovr" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="active" value="auto"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="active" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="fresh" value="yes"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="active" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="rule2" value="no"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="fresh" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="model" value="yes"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="fresh" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="stale" value="no"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
